critical_code_review_comments: routes/factions.py is now ~1700+ lines (Phase A endpoints near 437-475, Phase B charter near 800-1160, Phase C tick/npcs near 1600+). It is well over the 700-line soft cap. Consider splitting into factions_charters.py + factions_npcs_routes.py + factions_visibility.py once feature pace slows.

faction_npcs.tick_faction throttle is implemented via a single `factions.npc_tick_at` timestamp. Two simultaneous /tick calls within the same millisecond would both pass the throttle check (a tiny race). Low-impact since tick is idempotent + best-effort, but worth tightening with $setOnInsert or a DB-level lock if NPC roster size grows.

Public POST /api/factions/{slug}/tick has no rate-limit beyond the 6h self-throttle — a hostile caller could not actually cause work (throttled) but could still cause one DB read per request. Consider adding lightweight per-IP throttling at the gateway.

Frontend FactionBadge renders nothing on null. That is correct per spec, but it also means the Dashboard/Characters smoke test cannot distinguish 'no characters in factions' from 'badge component broken'. Suggest adding `data-testid="character-faction-badge-slot-${characterId}"` on the slot wrapper so tests can assert presence-of-slot even when faction is null.
